summary: Agent executions intermittently fail after workload concurrency increases
impact: Approximately 34% of synthetic agent executions in the US test region return HTTP 503 while existing sessions remain available.
reproduction_steps: Submit 20 concurrent synthetic execution requests using the documented test payload.
Observe intermittent HTTP 503 responses while lower-concurrency requests succeed.
Match failed request correlation IDs to container restart events.

evidence.observation: Affected containers restarted with an out-of-memory termination reason.

hypotheses.statement: The concurrency increase may cause containers to exceed their memory limits.

workaround_status: Reducing synthetic test concurrency prevents the observed failures.
engineering_question: Can engineering confirm whether the new workload configuration increased per-request memory consumption?

customer_update.current_impact: Synthetic agent executions remain degraded at high concurrency.
customer_update.actions_taken: The issue was reproduced, request failures were correlated with container restarts, and a concurrency reduction was validated as a temporary workaround.
